description: Cybersecurity obligations and operational resilience requirements. Spans financial services, critical infrastructure, and cross-sector essential-service regimes.

regulatory_bodies.name: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority
New York Department of Financial Services
Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions
Australian Cyber and Infrastructure Security Centre

regulations.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act
regulations.summary: Harmonised ICT risk framework across EU financial services.
key_requirements: Major ICT incident classification and reporting
Digital operational resilience testing including TLPT
Third-party risk management; register of information
Oversight regime for critical ICT third-party providers

regulations.name: NIS 2 Directive
regulations.summary: Updated EU cybersecurity directive with tiered obligations for essential and important entities.
key_requirements: Governance — management body approval and oversight
Incident reporting — 24h early warning, 72h notification, 1 month final report
Fines up to €10m or 2% turnover for essential entities

regulations.name: Network and Information Systems Regulations 2018
regulations.issuing_body: UK Government (retained from EU NIS Directive)
regulations.summary: UK cybersecurity obligations for operators of essential services and relevant digital service providers. Under review — NIS 2-equivalent UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill in development.
key_requirements: Appropriate technical and organisational security measures
Notify significant incidents to competent authority

regulations.name: FCA/PRA Operational Resilience Policy
regulations.summary: Firms identify important business services (IBS), set impact tolerances, and demonstrate ability to remain within tolerance through severe but plausible disruption.

regulations.name: NYDFS 23 NYCRR Part 500 — Cybersecurity Regulation
regulations.summary: Cybersecurity requirements for NYDFS-regulated entities. Significant 2023 amendments.
key_requirements: Written cybersecurity programme based on risk assessment
Incident notification to NYDFS within 72h; extortion payment notification within 24h

regulations.name: OSFI Guideline B-13 — Technology and Cyber Risk Management
regulations.summary: Principles-based expectations for technology and cyber risk at FRFIs.
key_requirements: Governance — accountable senior officer, board oversight
Cyber security controls (identity, data, incident response)

regulations.name: OSFI Guideline B-10 — Third-Party Risk Management
regulations.summary: Expectations for third-party risk management across the lifecycle.
key_requirements: Due diligence and risk assessment pre-onboarding
Written arrangements covering data, subcontracting, audit, exit
Ongoing monitoring and concentration risk management
Material third-party incident notification to OSFI

regulations.name: APRA Prudential Standard CPS 234 — Information Security
regulations.summary: Information security requirements with board-level accountability.
key_requirements: Information security capability commensurate with threats
Incident management; notification to APRA within 72h

regulations.name: APRA Prudential Standard CPS 230 — Operational Risk Management
regulations.summary: Operational risk and resilience framework replacing CPS 231, CPS 232.
key_requirements: Critical operations identified; impact tolerances set
Business continuity plans tested to impact tolerance
Material service provider register; ongoing due diligence
APRA notification for critical operation disruptions and service provider incidents

regulations.name: Security of Critical Infrastructure Act
regulations.summary: Framework protecting critical infrastructure across 11 sectors.
key_requirements: Mandatory cyber incident reporting (12h critical, 72h other)
Positive Security Obligations — risk management programme
Systems of National Significance — enhanced obligations

regulations.name: MAS Technology Risk Management Guidelines
regulations.summary: Principles for sound technology risk management. 2021 enhancements.
key_requirements: Access, network, data security and cryptography
Cyber security — intelligence, defence, detection, response

regulations.name: MAS Notice 655 — Cyber Hygiene
regulations.summary: Mandatory cyber hygiene practices for banks (similar notices apply to other MAS-regulated sectors).

regulations.name: MAS Guidelines on Outsourcing
regulations.summary: Principles for managing outsourcing (including cloud) risks.
key_requirements: Written arrangements covering data, audit rights, BCM, exit, subcontracting
Risk assessment and ongoing due diligence

regulations.name: Singapore Cybersecurity Act
regulations.summary: Protects Critical Information Infrastructure across 11 sectors.

regulations.name: FINMA Circular 2023/1 — Operational Risk and Resilience (banks)
regulations.summary: Principles-based operational risk and resilience requirements.
key_requirements: Cyber risk management — protect, detect, respond, recover
Business continuity management with critical function identification
Operational resilience — critical function disruption tolerance within 2 years

regulations.name: BACEN Resolution 4,893 — Cybersecurity and Cloud Services
regulations.summary: Cybersecurity policy and requirements for use of data processing, data storage, and cloud services. Successor to Resolution 4,658.
key_requirements: Due diligence on service providers including cloud
BACEN prior notification for material cloud contracting
Data location / cross-border rules by criticality
